# Lab 18.12: Audit Logs for BigQuery

## What We Are Going to Do
Read BigQuery's Admin Activity and Data Access audit logs, route them to BigQuery with a log sink, and answer "who read which table?"

## Steps

1. **[Console] Read logs in Logs Explorer.** Go to **Logging → Logs Explorer** and run:


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • TEXT
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">protoPayload.serviceName="bigquery.googleapis.com"
logName:"cloudaudit.googleapis.com%2Fdata_access"</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


   Open an entry and find `principalEmail`, `methodName` and the table name.

2. **[CLI] Create a sink to BigQuery.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">bq --location=US mk --dataset $PROJECT_ID:lab18_audit
gcloud logging sinks create bq-audit-sink \
  bigquery.googleapis.com/projects/$PROJECT_ID/datasets/lab18_audit \
  --log-filter='protoPayload.serviceName="bigquery.googleapis.com"' --use-partitioned-tables
WRITER=$(gcloud logging sinks describe bq-audit-sink --format="value(writerIdentity)")
bq query --use_legacy_sql=false "GRANT \`roles/bigquery.dataEditor\` ON SCHEMA lab18_audit TO '$WRITER'"</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


3. **[SQL] Generate some activity,** then wait a few minutes:


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">SELECT COUNT(*) FROM lab18.sales;</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


4. **[SQL] Who read what?**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">SELECT
  timestamp,
  protopayload_auditlog.authenticationInfo.principalEmail AS who,
  protopayload_auditlog.methodName AS action,
  protopayload_auditlog.resourceName AS resource
FROM `lab18_audit.cloudaudit_googleapis_com_data_access`
WHERE DATE(timestamp) = CURRENT_DATE()
ORDER BY timestamp DESC
LIMIT 20;</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


5. **[SQL] A faster option for queries only.** For "who ran which query", `INFORMATION_SCHEMA.JOBS` is often enough:


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">SELECT user_email, creation_time, referenced_tables
FROM `region-us`.INFORMATION_SCHEMA.JOBS
WHERE creation_time &gt; TIMESTAMP_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 1 DAY)
ORDER BY creation_time DESC LIMIT 20;</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


## Expected Result

| Thing | Reality |
|---|---|
| Admin Activity | Create, delete, change permissions |
| Data Access | Reads and queries |
| Sink | Logs land in partitioned BigQuery tables |
| JOBS view | Quick query history per user |
